facts.fact: StackAdapt's vendor blog says its Third-Party Catalogue lets users browse over 150,000 available segments on the platform.
facts.quote: Simply, it acts as a lookbook to browse over 150,000 available segments on our platform.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's vendor blog says third-party audience data sets are available directly through data intelligence partners Clickagy and 33Across.
facts.quote: curated data sets that are available directly through data intelligence partners like

facts.fact: StackAdapt's vendor blog says the Third-Party Catalogue lets users filter segments by geo, audience size, provider, and CPM.
facts.quote: with the ability to filter by geo, audience size, provider, CPM, etc..

facts.fact: StackAdapt's vendor blog says third-party audiences can narrow targeting by demographics, firmographics, income, or interests.
facts.quote: You can use these audience data sets to narrow in on specific user targeting characteristics, such as demographics, firmographics, income, or even interests.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's vendor blog says its partnerships with third-party data intelligence partners help keep campaigns compliant in sensitive verticals such as healthcare, alcohol, and cannabis.
facts.quote: stay compliant in sensitive verticals (i.e. healthcare, alcohol, and cannabis).
